previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A woman with a history of type 2 diabetes, gastroparesis, and anxiety was admitted for severe abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and poor glycemic control. She presented with elevated lactate and dehydration, consistent with a gastroparesis flare complicated by hyperglycemia. Imaging showed no acute abnormalities, and her elevated white count and lactate were attributed to metabolic stress. She improved with IV fluids, insulin adjustment, and pain management. Her diet was advanced, and she stabilized. A new insulin regimen was initiated with home nursing support arranged. She was discharged home in stable condition with follow-up plans for diabetes and iron management.
